title: Vòng tay đêm
about: Round x6, for sleep (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa, phù hợp cho các người nghe có thể nghe để ngủ"): held by the night: low strings, soft and close, rocking between two chords, a deep sub and the pad under them; once, a single string sings a short tune. C minor at 48 bpm, about six minutes. Nothing sudden: no thunder, heartbeat or struck bells. An original piece.
